newsitem.title: CYPRUS: Cyprus police arrest six for embassy threat.
newsitem.headline: Cyprus police arrest six for embassy threat.

text.p: Cyprus police on Thursday arrested four Pakistanis and two Syrians on suspicion of plotting an attack on a western embassy on the island.
"They were arrested for (making) threats against a foreign embassy on the island," police spokesman Glafcos Xenos told Reuters. He refused to elaborate.
The suspects were apprehended after a police stakeout at a house they were leasing in the southern coastal town of Limassol.
They will appear in court on Friday.
"They tried to escape when they saw police so warning shots were fired," Xenos said, adding that documents, two computers and a fax machine were confiscated in the raid.
